title: Dinosaurs Before Dark
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie find a magic tree house full of books. When Jack wishes to see a Pteranodon, the tree house spins them 65 million years into the past — and a real dinosaur adventure begins! 🌳🦕

title: The Knight at Dawn
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie sneak into a misty castle and meet a brave knight in shining armor — 杰克和安妮溜进雾蒙蒙的城堡，遇见一位身穿闪亮盔甲的勇敢骑士！🌳

title: Mummies in the Morning
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie explore a pyramid in ancient Egypt and help a ghost-queen find her lost book — 杰克和安妮在古埃及探秘金字塔，帮幽灵女王找回失落的书！🌳

title: Pirates Past Noon
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie meet Captain Bones and a talking parrot, and learn the truth about Morgan — 杰克和安妮遇上邦斯船长与一只会说话的鹦鹉，还揭开了摩根的真面目！🌳

title: Night of the Ninjas
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie meet real ninjas in old Japan and learn to follow nature — 杰克和安妮在古代日本遇见真正的忍者，学会了跟随自然！🌳

title: Afternoon on the Amazon
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie explore the Amazon rain forest and meet jaguars, piranhas, and a helpful monkey — 杰克和安妮探秘亚马逊雨林，遇见美洲豹、食人鱼和一只热心的猴子！🌳

title: Sunset of the Sabertooth
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie journey to the Ice Age to find the third 'M' thing — and a woolly mammoth named Lulu helps them escape a sabertooth! 🦣 杰克和安妮来到冰河时代寻找第三件“M”宝物，长毛象露露还帮他们逃过了剑齿虎！

title: Midnight on the Moon
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: At midnight Jack and Annie blast to a moon base in the future to find the last 'M' thing — a surprise hiding in plain sight! 🌙 午夜时分，杰克和安妮飞到未来的月球基地，寻找最后一件“M”宝物——一个一直就在眼前的惊喜！

title: Dolphins at Daybreak
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie dive in a mini-sub to solve a riddle, meet shy octopuses and a shark, and are rescued by two brave dolphins! 🐬 杰克和安妮坐迷你潜艇下海解谜，遇见害羞的章鱼和鲨鱼，还被两只勇敢的海豚救了！

title: Ghost Town at Sundown
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: In a Wild West ghost town, Jack and Annie help a lost colt find his mother — and discover the answer is an echo! 👻 在狂野西部的鬼镇上，杰克和安妮帮一只迷路的小马找妈妈，还发现谜底原来是“回声”！

title: Lions at Lunchtime
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: On the African plains, Jack and Annie meet giraffes, hyenas, a honey-guide bird, and a hungry lion — and learn the answer is honey! 🦁 在非洲草原上，杰克和安妮遇见长颈鹿、鬣狗、指蜜鸟和饥饿的狮子，还发现谜底是蜂蜜！

title: Polar Bears Past Bedtime
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie meet a polar bear on the frozen Arctic ice! 杰克和安妮在冰封的北极冰原上遇见了北极熊！

title: Vacation Under the Volcano
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie race to save a Roman scroll as Vesuvius erupts! 维苏威火山喷发时，杰克和安妮拼命去抢救一卷古罗马书卷！

title: Day of the Dragon King
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie save an ancient Chinese legend from the Dragon King's fire! 杰克和安妮从龙王的烈火中抢救出一个中国古代传说！

title: Viking Ships at Sunrise
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie meet kind monks and a giant sea serpent in Ireland! 杰克和安妮在爱尔兰遇见善良的修士和巨大的海中巨蛇！

title: Hour of the Olympics
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie cheer at the first Olympics and ride the winged horse Pegasus! 杰克和安妮在古代奥运会呐喊助威，还骑上了长翅膀的飞马珀伽索斯！

title: Tonight on the Titanic
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie visit the famous ship on its very first — and last — voyage. 杰克和安妮登上了那艘著名巨轮的处女航，也是最后一夜。🚢

title: Buffalo Before Breakfast
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie meet the Lakota people on the Great Plains and learn from the buffalo. 杰克和安妮在大平原上遇见拉科塔人，向野牛学习。🐃

title: Tigers at Twilight
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie explore the wild forests of India and meet tigers, elephants, and a kind hermit. 杰克和安妮走进印度的原始森林，遇见老虎、大象和一位善良的隐士。🐅

title: Dingoes at Dinnertime
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie visit the Australian outback, meet koalas and kangaroos, and face a wildfire. 杰克和安妮来到澳大利亚内陆，遇见考拉和袋鼠，还遭遇了森林大火。🦘

title: Civil War on Sunday
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie travel to the American Civil War and meet the brave nurse Clara Barton. 杰克和安妮穿越到美国南北战争时期，遇见了勇敢的护士克拉拉·巴顿。🕊️

title: Revolutionary War on Wednesday
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie cross the icy Delaware with George Washington on Christmas! / 杰克和安妮在圣诞节跟随乔治·华盛顿横渡结冰的特拉华河！🌳

title: Twister on Tuesday
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie survive a Kansas tornado and learn 'try, try again'! / 杰克和安妮在堪萨斯躲过龙卷风，学到了「再试一次」！🌪️

title: Earthquake in the Early Morning
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie ride out the great San Francisco earthquake of 1906 and learn that even small acts of kindness matter! / 杰克和安妮亲历1906年旧金山大地震，明白了小小的善举也很重要！🌍

title: Stage Fright on a Summer Night
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie perform in Shakespeare's play and save a dancing bear in old London! / 杰克和安妮在古老的伦敦登上莎士比亚的舞台，还救了一只会跳舞的熊！🎭

title: Good Morning, Gorillas
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie learn to 'talk' with gorillas using sign language in an African rain forest! / 杰克和安妮在非洲雨林里用手语和大猩猩「聊天」！🦍

title: Thanksgiving on Thursday
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie travel to 1621 Plymouth to help the Pilgrims and Wampanoag host the very first Thanksgiving feast! 🦃

title: High Tide in Hawaii
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: In old Hawaii, Jack and Annie learn to surf, meet new friends, and escape a giant tsunami together! 🌺🏄

title: Christmas in Camelot
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: On a Merlin mission, Jack and Annie travel to a joyless Camelot and brave the Otherworld to bring back magic! 🎄🏰

title: Haunted Castle on Hallows Eve
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: On Halloween, Jack, Annie, and Teddy become ravens to win back the Diamond of Destiny from the Raven King! 👻🦅

title: Summer of the Sea Serpent
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: On the summer solstice, Jack and Annie turn into seals to find Excalibur and face a giant sea serpent! 🌊🐉

title: Winter of the Ice Wizard
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie journey to the frozen Land-Behind-the-Clouds to find the Ice Wizard's lost eye. 杰克和安妮冒险前往冰雪之境，帮冰巫师找回失去的眼睛！❄️

title: Carnival at Candlelight
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie travel to Carnival-time Venice to save the city from a great flood. 杰克和安妮在狂欢节的威尼斯，设法拯救即将被洪水淹没的水城！🎭

title: Season of the Sandstorms
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie ride camels to the golden age of Baghdad to deliver a book of wisdom. 杰克和安妮骑着骆驼来到黄金时代的巴格达，送出一册充满智慧的书！🐪

title: Night of the New Magicians
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie race up the Eiffel Tower to meet four 'magicians' of science in 1889 Paris. 杰克和安妮在1889年的巴黎登顶埃菲尔铁塔，遇见四位“科学魔法师”！🗼

title: Blizzard of the Blue Moon
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie travel to New York City in 1938 to save the last unicorn before the blue moon rises. With rhyming magic, a foggy escape, and a snowy parade, they help a glowing unicorn named Dianthus find his way home. 🦄❄️

title: Dragon of the Red Dawn
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie travel to old Japan to find a secret of happiness — and ride a rain-making dragon to save the city of Edo! 🐉🌸

title: Monday With a Mad Genius
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie spend a Monday helping Leonardo da Vinci — and learn that curiosity is the real secret of happiness! 🎨🐦

title: Dark Day in the Deep Sea
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie sail on a science ship and learn that compassion for all creatures is the real secret of happiness! 🐙🌊

title: Eve of the Emperor Penguin
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie travel to icy Antarctica to find the fourth secret of happiness. Deep inside a glowing ice cavern, they meet a royal emperor penguin and a brave little orphan who changes everything! 🐧

title: Moonlight on the Magic Flute
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie travel to a grand summer palace in 1762 Vienna. With a magic silver flute, they help a tiny, stubborn boy named Wolfie — who turns out to be the young Mozart — find his way to sharing music with the world! 🪈

title: A Good Night for Ghosts
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie travel to New Orleans in 1915 to meet a barefoot boy called Dipper — the future King of Jazz, Louis Armstrong! 🎺

title: Leprechaun in Late Winter
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie travel to Ireland in 1862 to inspire a serious girl named Augusta — and meet a tricky leprechaun named Willy! 🍀

title: A Ghost Tale for Christmas Time
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie travel to London in 1843 to cheer up a sad Charles Dickens — and inspire him to write A Christmas Carol! 🎻

title: A Crazy Day with Cobras
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie travel to Mogul India to find a magic emerald rose and save a little stone penguin! 🐍

title: Dogs in the Dead of Night
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie turn into Saint Bernard dogs for an hour to save a lost puppy and find a magic buttercup in the snowy Alps! 🐶

title: Abe Lincoln at Last!
titleZh: 亚伯拉罕·林肯终于出现！
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie visit the White House to meet President Lincoln and bring him a feather of hope! 🌳

title: A Perfect Time for Pandas
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie rush to a panda center in China to rescue giant pandas during a big earthquake! 🐼

title: Stallion by Starlight
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie travel to ancient Macedonia to meet young Alexander and tame a wild black stallion! 🐎

title: Hurry Up, Houdini!
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie travel to Coney Island in 1908 to learn a secret of greatness from the Great Houdini — and end up on stage themselves! 🎩

title: High Time for Heroes
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie sail the Nile in 1850 to meet Florence Nightingale and learn a third secret of greatness — and a brave rescue makes them heroes, too! 💡

title: Soccer on Sunday
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie travel to the 1970 World Cup in Mexico City to learn Pelé's secret of greatness — and discover that enthusiasm is everything! ⚽

title: Shadow of the Shark
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie's dream vacation to Cozumel turns into a real Mayan adventure — complete with a shark, a secret underworld, and a brave girl named Heart-of-the-Wind! 🦈

title: Balto of the Blue Dawn
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie race through a blizzard in 1925 Alaska to help deliver life-saving medicine — with a heroic dog named Balto leading the way! 🐕

title: Night of the Ninth Dragon
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie race to save wounded King Arthur and find the missing gold dragon! 🐉 杰克和安妮赶去拯救受伤的亚瑟王，寻找失踪的金龙！
